prompt: Write a ~300-word professional workplace message about: declining a vendor proposal politely. Plain prose.
text:
Subject: Update Regarding Your Proposal for [Project Name/Service]

Dear [Vendor Contact Name],

Thank you very much for submitting your comprehensive proposal and for the significant time and effort your team invested in presenting such a detailed solution to our needs at [Company Name]. We genuinely appreciate the thoroughness of your documentation, particularly regarding your technical specifications and compliance frameworks. It is evident that you have done extensive research into our industry landscape.

After careful internal review by our procurement committee and stakeholders, we are writing to inform you that we will not be moving forward with this specific proposal at this time. This was a difficult decision, as the solution presented demonstrated strong potential for addressing several of our current challenges. However, after weighing all options against our immediate strategic priorities and budgetary constraints for the upcoming fiscal quarter, we have decided to pursue an alternative approach that better aligns with our timeline requirements right now.

Please accept this letter not as a reflection on your capabilities or the quality of your work, but rather as a result of our current operational context. We are actively seeking partners who can support us in meeting a critical deadline set for [Month/Quarter], and unfortunately, we must proceed differently under these specific circumstances. That said, we intend to keep your information on file should our needs evolve or if our project scope expands significantly by the next business cycle.

We want to ensure you are not left without feedback that might be helpful for future engagements with us. Our team found your pricing structure competitive; however, the implementation timeline outlined in your proposal is slightly longer than what we can accommodate given our current resource availability. We hope this provides some clarity on where there was a misalignment between your offering and our immediate operational reality.

We thank you again for considering [Company Name] as a potential partner. We wish you continued success with other prospects, and I will certainly reach out if circumstances change in the future that would make us reconsider engaging with vendors like yours. Sincerely hope to cross paths professionally down the road.
